text:
This role keeps coming up. And the right person for it is genuinely rare.
 
 AI Engineer (MLOps / Production ML)
 Remote (EU timezone) · 9-month initial engagement · Senior
 
 The client: a German enterprise software company, 600+ engineers, serious AI ambitions. They have data scientists who can build models. They have a cloud team that can provision infrastructure. What they don't have is the person who sits between those two functions and makes the whole thing work at production scale.
 
 That's the role.
 
 What it involves:
 
 Taking models from experimentation to production — repeatedly, reliably, at enterprise scale. Building and maintaining MLOps infrastructure: model versioning, monitoring, retraining pipelines, automated rollback. Working with the data science team to define what "production-ready" means and then actually getting things there. Cloud: AWS or Azure. Stack includes SageMaker or AzureML, MLflow, Kubernetes.
 
 What separates the right person from the wrong one:
 
 They've shipped ML systems that ran for 12+ months without heroics. They understand that model performance in production is an engineering problem, not a research problem. They can explain trade-offs between latency, cost, and accuracy to a product manager — and get alignment.
 
 7+ years engineering experience, at least 3 in ML infrastructure or MLOps roles.
 
 Start: within 4 weeks.
 
 The hiring manager knows what they need. The brief is clear. The process is fast.
